name: KRN brain layer boundary
decision: KRN should behave as a governed RAG, memory, source, review, and feedback layer around Codex execution: Codex executes, while KRN selects bounded context, exposes source-grounded evidence, records proof boundaries, and keeps maintenance preview as candidate-only contracts until a named product loop requires execution. Maintenance preview is not Codex exec; it is candidate maintenance contract readback. The naming standard is no vanity rename: apply the helper extraction rule only when it removes duplication, names a reviewed domain concept, moves boundary logic, or reduces unsafe casts/parser drift.
consumers: future brain/search planning queries about maintenance-preview and Codex execution boundaries
future kernel roadmap selection after cleanup waves
falsifier: A future plan, brief, or brain/search readback treats maintenance preview as Codex execution, claims maintenance runtime enforcement before plnv is explicitly un-deferred, performs a vanity naming sweep without review-cost evidence, or extracts helpers that do not remove duplication, name a domain concept, move boundary logic, or reduce unsafe casts/parser drift.
doesNotProve: This card does not prove retrieval ranking quality, source truth, maintenance runtime, product readiness, or that every current KRN file already follows the brain layer model.
